Here is the complete Crossplane XRD and Composition using the modern `function-patch-and-transform` mode. The implementation strictly follows the canonical scenario spec and acceptance criteria.

### 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)
Defines the contract for consumers. Parameters drive environment-specific sizing, region, and naming.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: spineinfrastructures.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: SpineInfrastructure
    plural: spineinfrastructures
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              parameters:
                type: object
                properties:
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: [dev, prod]
                    description: Target environment (dev or prod)
                  region:
                    type: string
                    description: AWS region for resource deployment
                  bucketName:
                    type: string
                    description: Base name for the S3 bucket
                  instanceClass:
                    type: string
                    description: RDS instance class (e.g., db.t3.micro, db.t3.medium)
                  multiAZ:
                    type: boolean
                    description: Enable multi-AZ deployment (prod only)
                  iamRoleName:
                    type: string
                    description: Base name for the IAM service role
                required:
                - environment
                - region
                - bucketName
                - instanceClass
```

### 2. Composition (Function Mode)
Provisions S3, RDS, and IAM resources. Uses `function-patch-and-transform` for declarative patching and environment-aware transforms.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: spine-infrastructure
spec:
  type:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: SpineInfrastructure
  mode: Functions
  functions:
  - reference:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
  resources:
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 1. S3 Bucket: Versioned, Encrypted, Public Access Blocked
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: s3-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
          versioningConfiguration:
            status: Enabled
          bucketEncryption:
            serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - algorithm: AES256
          publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
            blockPublicAcls: true
            blockPublicPolicy: true
            ignorePublicAcls: true
            restrictPublicBuckets: true
    function:
      patch:
      - from: metadata.name
        to: metadata.name
        policy:
          from: Required
      - from: spec.parameters.region
        to: spec.forProvider.region
      - from: spec.parameters.bucketName
        to: spec.forProvider.bucketName
        transform:
        - type: String
          string:
            type:
